We will measure execution performance through test durations and runtime profiling to isolate performance bottlenecks across application layers.

steps.title: Profile test suite execution durations

steps.title: Analyze static code paths for algorithmic and blocking I/O hotspots

payload.result:
### Target Modules Inspection & Preparation Summary

The codebase has been inspected across all primary modules, AST symbols, headers, and dependency graphs. Below is the structural and dependency map for the target codebase.

---

### 1. Architectural Overview & Module Layout

The project (`crossvulkan` / `xfsr`) provides low-overhead dual-GPU upscaling and Vulkan layer interception:

* **Core Subsystem (`src/`):**
  * `src/offload_roundtrip.{hpp,cpp}`: Fused 3-stage pipelined asynchronous offload engine (`dGPU` $\to$ `iGPU` $\to$ `dGPU`).
  * `src/frame_transfer.{hpp,cpp}`: Multi-slot buffer ring, host-imported memory (`VK_EXT_external_memory_host`), dma-buf fallback, and pipeline synchronization.
  * `src/fsr_pass.{hpp,cpp}` / `src/fsr3_pass.{hpp,cpp}`: AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR 1.0 EASU + RCAS and FSR 3.x integration).
  * `src/gpu_image.{hpp,cpp}`: Vulkan image allocation, layout transitions, format management.
  * `src/dual_devices.{hpp,cpp}`: Multi-GPU context discovery and management (`DeviceContext`, queue families for graphics & copy engines).
  * `src/present.{hpp,cpp}`: Presentation abstractions and blit/composition pipelines.
  * `src/hud_overlay.{hpp,cpp}`: Real-time telemetry, frame timing, and HUD rendering.
* **Vulkan Layer (`layer/`):**
  * `layer/xfsr_layer.cpp`: Layer entry points (`xfsr_CreateSwapchainKHR`, `xfsr_AcquireNextImageKHR`, `xfsr_QueuePresentKHR`, `xfsr_GetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR`), proxy swapchain management, Wayland/X11 extent resolution, and offload pipeline invocation.
* **OpenGL / Wayland Interop (`gl/`):**
  * `gl/xfsr_gl_shim.c`: Dynamic library shim for `wl_egl_window` / EGL / GL swapchain sizing and hint dispatch.
* **Benchmarks & Harnesses (`bench/`, `scripts/`):**
  * `bench/xfsr_load_vk.cpp`, `bench/xfsr_load_gl.cpp`: Vulkan and GL headless/windowed load generators.
  * `scripts/xfsr-bench.sh`: Automated multi-configuration benchmark suite.

---

### 2. AST Symbols & Signatures Map

#### `src/offload_roundtrip.hpp` / `src/offload_roundtrip.cpp`
* `struct OffloadRoundTrip`
  * `static const GpuImage& submit(FrameTransfer& fwd, FrameTransfer& back, FsrPass& fsr, const GpuImage& appImage, uint32_t waitSemCount, const VkSemaphore* waitSems, const VkPipelineStageFlags* waitStages, VkImageLayout appLayout = VK_IMAGE_LAYOUT_PRESENT_SRC_KHR)`
    * Coordinates 3-stage software pipeline across slots (`fwd` download $\to$ `iGPU` fused upload/FSR/download $\to$ `back` upload $\to$ present).
  * `static bool legacyRequested()`
    * Queries `XFSR_RT_LEGACY` environment variable for A/B testing against legacy serialized round trip.

#### `src/frame_transfer.hpp` / `src/frame_transfer.cpp`
* `struct FrameTransfer::Slot`
  * Buffers & Images: `srcBuf`, `dstBuf`, `dstOptimal`, `hostMemPtr`
  * Fences & Cmds: `srcFence`, `dstFence`, `srcCmd`, `dstCmd`
  * State: `pendingUpload`
* `struct FrameTransfer`
  * Constants: `kSlots = 3`
  * State: `produceIndex`, `framesProduced`, `roundTripReady`
  * Methods:
    * `void init(DeviceContext* src, DeviceContext* dst)`
    * `void resize(uint32_t w, uint32_t h, VkFormat fmt, TransferBackend backend)`
    * `void resetPipeline()`
    * `const GpuImage& transferPipeline(...)`
    * `void recordDownload(VkCommandBuffer cmd, const GpuImage& srcOptimal, VkImageLayout appLayout)`
    * `void recordUpload(VkCommandBuffer cmd, int slot)`
    * `bool usesGpuBuffer() const`

#### `layer/xfsr_layer.cpp`
* Interception Functions:
  * `VkResult xfsr_CreateSwapchainKHR(VkDevice, const VkSwapchainCreateInfoKHR*, const VkAllocationCallbacks*, VkSwapchainKHR*)`
  * `VkResult xfsr_QueuePresentKHR(VkQueue, const VkPresentInfoKHR*)`
  * `VkResult xfsr_AcquireNextImageKHR(VkDevice, VkSwapchainKHR, uint64_t, VkSemaphore, VkFence, uint32_t*)`
  * `VkResult xfsr_GetPhysicalDeviceSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR(VkPhysicalDevice, VkSurfaceKHR, VkSurfaceCapabilitiesKHR*)`
* Key Internal Helpers:
  * `bool setupOffloadPipeline(ProxySwapchain*, VkSwapchainKHR, VkSwapchainKHR, bool)`
  * `bool displayExtentHint(InstanceData*, uint32_t*, uint32_t*)`
  * `bool queryTrueSurfaceExtent(DeviceData*, VkSurfaceKHR, uint32_t*, uint32_t*)`

---

### 3. Dependency & Include Hierarchy

```
layer/xfsr_layer.cpp
├── offload_roundtrip.hpp
│   ├── frame_transfer.hpp
│   │   ├── dual_devices.hpp -> common.hpp, vulkan_context.hpp
│   │   └── gpu_image.hpp
│   └── fsr_pass.hpp -> gpu_image.hpp, common.hpp
├── xfsr_controls.hpp
└── hud_overlay.hpp
```

---

### 4. Build & Environment Verification

* CMake configuration and compilation succeeded cleanly across targets:
  * `libxfsr_core.a` (Core library including `offload_roundtrip.o` and `frame_transfer.o`)
  * `libVkLayer_XFSR.so` (Vulkan layer)
  * `libxfsr_gl_shim.so` (GL/Wayland shim)
  * Shaders compilation verified (`shaders` target built).

Ready for Step 2 and subsequent tasks.
